title: U.S. passport - first-time application
facts: Most first-time adult U.S. passport applicants apply in person using Form DS-11.
DS-11 applicants generally provide evidence of U.S. citizenship, acceptable photo identification, a passport photo, and applicable fees.
An applicant should not sign Form DS-11 until instructed to do so by the acceptance agent.
Eligibility and procedure differ for children, renewals, urgent travel, and some special circumstances.
